messages.subject: using pdf2text via system command
parts:
Hi,
I have to convert pdf and docx files to text documents before using the tm package for a shiny app. The tm package's readPDF() function uses pdf2text installed on my machine and the readDOC uses antiword tool on my machine to convert these files to text format. Can you please tell me if I will be able to deploy this app on shinnyapps.io?
Also do simple system calls like making a dir work?
Thanks.
Hena
